title: THE SPIRIT IS MOVING!

blocks.text: We are living in a world of fantastic and fascinating changes! Very little for good, but most for the worst, and the latter will not get any better! “As the Spirit saith, we know the time of all things is at hand!” Time is short. Men speak of rare commodities, but the most valuable of all is our time that is left. – “Behold, saith the Lord, it is time to awaken!” Look up, the door is open and the time of our redemption is near! – We know the Church Age prophecies are finishing their final forecast. Times of the Gentiles are climaxing, and up shall the elect go! (Rev. chap. 4 – I Thess. 4:16-17) – “Watch saith the Lord lest all of these things come up on ye unaware like a snare that the prophets and chosen have prophesied!” – Note: Knowledge is increasing so fast that the population cannot keep up with all the new things that are occurring including the newer electronic era!

Luke 21:25 – Ps. 19 – The heavenly bodies are moving in their positions directly on time as signs! The Covenant is being prepared as the nations are in perplexities and some nations in war as predicted by the Scripts! Also the seas and the waves are in an uproar as the weather patterns and nature is breaking all records! Volcanoes are exploding, the earth is shaking and greater quakes and weather changes are coming and more of the latter in tremendous travailing! This is our day to rejoice! “Yea saith the Lord again, rejoice forevermore!” Right along with restoration, persecution will rise and dramatic world changes are coming. As God’s restoration is poured out we will be covered under the Holy Spirit wings and will be lifted up to meet Jesus! Just like He took Israel out of bondage, He said I will bear thee up and take you out on Eagle’s wings! The spirit is moving!

We know that after the Translation that there is a mark of the beast, the Great Tribulation, Atomic War, fire fragments, asteroids, Day of the Lord and cleansing of the earth! (Ezek. 39:8-14) – And fitting into the latter parts will be the building of the new Temple and the Millennium! “Behold, saith the Lord, this is no day to sleep. In the hour ye think not the Lord cometh! Remember ye are My witnesses, go ye forth! – Note: We are about to step into eternity!

Now I’m going to release the work and promises of the Holy Spirit to all my dear partners! – The Holy Spirit will reprove the world of sin, righteousness and judgement. (John 16:8) – “Except for the elect not all of this will be fulfilled until after Armageddon and the rest at the end of the Millennium!” – The Holy Spirit shall quicken the believer. – John 6:63, It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life. – “The elect are gradually leaving the flesh into a deep spiritual walk! It is occurring now! You talk about a quick short work coming, that is exactly what the Scripture says! We are now in an overwhelming power of the latter rain!” – Shall teach all things. – “The Holy Spirit said it would teach us all things, comfort us, and also show us things to come! Amen. – Shall guide us into all truth! – “The Holy Spirit also said, it would guide us into all truth and is doing so right now!” (John 16:13) – The Holy Spirit shall give power to witness! – We shall have power to witness. (Acts 1:8) – Personally and also helping in our harvest ministry!

Holy Spirit – Source of the New Birth! – John 3:8, The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the spirit. – “This Scripture shows the Holy Spirit is predestined where it goes!” – Spirit shall be a well of water springing up within! John 4:14, But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life. – “The water is symbolic of God’s salvation, spirit and the outpouring occurring; creating gifts, joy, peace, comfort and etc.” – John 7:37-38, In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink. He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

Luke 17:28-30, Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded; But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all. Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed. – This accurately predicts commercial activity of today (mark and etc.) in the very hour that we are living now! The key is this, we have preached about Jesus for several thousand years. But it says in the day that He is revealed. That is exactly what’s happening! – Isa. 9:6, the eternal one to the elect. He is King of the Thunders! A firestorm is coming and reveals in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye we will be gone, is thus saith the Lord! The testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy!
